title: Held-out evaluation + evidence card + demo
acceptance_criterion: A reviewer can reproduce an offline failure and inspect the basis for the shipping decision
stdout:
Phase 6 shipped. 24-run held-out experiment executed live on MiniMax-M3 for $0.0124 under a $5
SpendCeiling; raw per-run outcomes, a full dependency/code-SHA manifest, and the failed-case +
uncertainty writeups are committed. The evidence card summarises what was built and measured.

Honest gaps: (1) task_success is 0/24 under the conservative substring scorer, so the 'shipping
decision' rests on token-efficiency (fixed << single_agent) and the retrieval_recall signal
(1.0 on 5/6 families), not on an end-to-end success rate. (2) The planned git tag
experiment-v1-frozen was never cut. (3) docs/demo.md is a 5-minute script, not a recording.
evidence: experiments/held-out-v1/outcomes.jsonl = 24 lines (6 held-out cases x 2 topologies x 2 trials)
experiments/held-out-v1/manifest.json: provider=minimax, model=MiniMax-M3, prompt_version=v1_baseline, code_sha=a5b489b, budget max_usd=5.0, selected_topologies=[fixed, single_agent]
EVIDENCE_CARD totals: 9,074 tokens (5,782 prompt + 3,292 completion), $0.0124, 153.7s, held_out_sha256 d3bef8c3...d8d0a5
experiments/held-out-v1/{failed_cases.md,uncertainty.md} — 24/24 failed under the substring scorer; per-topology 0/12 each; caveats stated

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is reconstructed from the shipped artifacts under apps/agentops-workbench/ plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. exit_code / acceptance_met are judgements against the shipped tree, not a recorded process exit.
